title: SM4 Encryption
description: Chinese national standard SM4 symmetric encryption, supports ECB and CBC modes
aboutDesc: SM4 is a block cipher algorithm published by the Chinese State Cryptography Administration for wireless LAN products. It is a symmetric encryption algorithm with both key length and block length of 128 bits. SM4 has high security and is widely used in finance, government, and other fields.
errorNoPaddingLength: No-padding mode requires input length to be a multiple of 16
errorCiphertextLength: Ciphertext length must be a multiple of 16
errorHexLength: Hex string length must be even
